# Button Synth

Source: https://github.com/designerzen/button-synth

Pinned commit: `549a1a15b7c56789e5855ffe39f7d7763ed746c4`.

`synth.ts`, `game-profiles.ts` and `profiles.json` are unmodified upstream files,
copied using the repository's documented “Reuse the engine” integration.
Preserve `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` when updating these files.

Application-specific cue choices, volume settings and interaction handling live
in `../../app/interaction-feedback.ts` and `../../app/interaction-sounds.ts`.
